en.headline: Government to contact 13 Wang Fuk Court owners who rejected buy-out next month
en.dek: More than 96 percent of the estate’s households have signed to sell, with compulsory acquisition remaining a last resort, Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong said.
body: Hong Kong authorities will approach the 13 homeowners at Wang Fuk Court who have refused the government’s buy-out offer next month, Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong said on Thursday.

Wong said more than 96 percent of the estate’s 1,984 households had signed binding agreements to sell, with 1,914 having signed and more than 1,730 having completed the sale. Of the 70 households that had not signed, 57 said they wished to join the scheme but first had to resolve legal issues over ownership.

Compulsory resumption by legislation will only be taken as a last resort and will not be pursued this year, Wong added. Support for displaced residents continues on the first anniversary of the blaze that killed 168 people.

zh.headline: 政府下月接觸拒收購的13戶宏福苑業主
zh.dek: 財政司副司長黃偉綸表示，逾96%住戶已簽署出售協議，強制收回只會作為最後手段。
body: 財政司副司長黃偉綸周四表示，政府下月將接觸大埔宏福苑拒絕政府收購計劃的13戶業主。
黃偉綸稱，屋苑1984戶中逾96%已簽署具約束力的出售協議，其中1914戶已簽署，逾1730戶已完成交易。未簽署的70戶中，57戶表示希望加入計劃，但須先解決業權法律問題。
黃偉綸補充，立法強制收回只會作為最後手段，今年不會進行。火災造成168人死亡的一周年，政府繼續支援受影響居民。
